approval_note: Owner approved publishing this held case on a call on 12 Nov 2026 ('Okay, go ahead and start that'), after it was described as the filed August Sao Paulo seizure awaiting approval. Before publishing, the SARS release of 25 Aug 2026 was re-read for the date, the 333 kg, the 83.10 kg and 250 kg, R167 million and 'a flight arriving from Sao Paulo, Brazil', and The Citizen of 26 Aug 2026 for the police 'no arrests have been made at this stage'. A news search on 12 Nov 2026 found no later arrest.
title: More than 333 kg of cocaine found in luggage and cargo off one flight at OR Tambo
summary: SARS Customs found 75 bricks of cocaine (83.10 kg) in two suitcases in the international arrivals hall, and a detector dog found four boxes of unmanifested cargo off the same flight holding 250 kg. SARS put the street value at R167 million.
arrests: None at the time. Police spokesperson Athlenda Mathe said no arrests had been made.
case_key: Passenger bags and unmanifested cargo off the same flight, 25 Aug 2026

basis.quote: intercepted more than 333kg of cocaine during a targeted enforcement operation conducted at OR Tambo International Airport (ORTIA)
Mathe added that no arrests have been made at this stage following the discovery of the drugs.

far_ends.label: São Paulo, Brazil
far_ends.note: SARS names the city the flight came from, not the airport, and not where the drugs were first packed.

basis.quote: on a flight arriving from Sao Paulo, Brazil

disagreements: Value: SARS says R167 million; police (The Citizen, SABC) said more than R200 million.
Weight: SARS gives 83.10 kg in the suitcases; police said about 84 kg. Both give 250 kg in the cargo boxes.
Date: SARS dates its release 25 Aug and says 'today'. The Citizen wrote 'Tuesday, 26 August'; 25 Aug 2026 was the Tuesday.
excluded: Where the cocaine was meant to end up: no source names it.
